about: SCION 44 Multiplane Parallax: what the dog did, measured per scene frame from the render. x_world_measured: the centroid of the dog pass (alpha of every dog piece after all nearer occluders: wall jamb, railing) unprojected at the dog root depth with the moving camera is kept as x_centroid_world; x_world_measured is the torso (flank) piece as laid, unprojected at its laid depth (less disturbed by the head and tail). facing: from the skull and nose pieces as laid, unprojected at their laid depths (door = muzzle toward the threshold or deeper into the house than the skull). posture: from the back (saddle piece) height in metres. state is classified from those measurements only (speed of x_world_measured, facing, back height, head above back, near the sill); state_score is the score state that drove the acting. x_score is the score x that placed the dog root.

onsets_measured.to: looks in: muzzle heading (skull -> nose, laid pieces unprojected) within 22 deg of straight into the room (+Z)
